## Tasks and Calendars sloppy-Value JSCalendar properties use different container shapes
Crates: jmap-tasks-types, jmap-calendars-types
Evidence: For the same RFC 8984 properties, calendars-types/src/event.rs:175,179,183,213,217,281,290,318 use `Option<serde_json::Value>`, while tasks-types/src/task.rs:354,358,362,393,397,432,447,463 use `Option<BTreeMap<Id, Value>>` / `Option<Vec<Value>>`. Workspace AGENTS.md:407-419 names the calendars approach (public field as serde_json::Value) as the preferred hybrid. Not a conformance bug: both shapes can carry any conforming value. It is a sibling divergence.
Why breaking later: Unifying either sibling later changes public field types, which is a semver break.
Fix: Pick one shape for both crates before 0.4. Either align tasks to calendars' Option<Value> per AGENTS.md, or record the divergence as deliberate.
Size: S

Votes: REAL: I could not refute it. The divergence is real at HEAD, can only be fixed later with a semver break, and goes against both the workspace rule and tasks-types' own design doc.

(a) The evidence holds.

- crate-jmap-tasks-types/src/task.rs uses a different shape for the same RFC 8984 properties:

Both crates are publishable, and changing either one after 0.4 would be a semver break.
